references.text: Joshua sends men to pursue the enemies, in the same way that Ehud commands the Israelites to pursue the Moabites
Joshua urges the people to chase their enemies and not let them escape, similar to Ehud's order to take control of the fords
Gideon sends messengers to seize the fords at the Jordan before the Midianites, the same strategy that Ehud used against the Moabites
The Gileadites took the fords at the Jordan against the Ephraimites, using the same tactic that Ehud employed against Moab
The Lord gives the enemy into Israel's hand, the same promise that Ehud gave to the Israelites that the Lord had given Moab into their hands
Deborah declares that the Lord has given Sisera into Barak's hand, corresponding to Ehud's declaration that the Lord had given Moab into the hands of the Israelites
David declares that the Lord grants victory and delivers enemies, similar to Ehud's proclamation of the Lord delivering Moab
